visual_action: Barack Obama, wearing a suit jacket and a blue collared shirt, sits in a chair and speaks directly to the camera in a room with neutral-toned walls. He gestures with his hands as he speaks.

cast.name: Barack Obama
cast.evidence: He is the sole speaker in the video, delivering the entire message directly to the camera.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: Obama states, "it's critical to get out the vote for Democrats up and down the ballot."

on_screen_text.text: With so much at stake in the midterm elections coming up,
it's critical to get out the vote for Democrats up and down the ballot.
The power to protect reproductive rights
and codify Roe is in our hands.
We just have to use it.
to make a plan to vote today.

spoken_summary: Barack Obama directly addresses the audience, stating that with the midterm elections approaching, it is critical to vote for Democrats. He emphasizes that the power to protect reproductive rights and codify Roe v. Wade is in the voters' hands and urges them not to wait. He concludes by directing viewers to IWillVote.com to make a voting plan.
audio_music: The video consists solely of Barack Obama's spoken dialogue. There is no background music or any other sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot of a person speaking directly to the camera (a talking-head style).
central_claim: Voters must vote for Democrats in the upcoming midterm elections to protect reproductive rights.
intended_effect: To motivate viewers to vote for the Democratic party in the midterm elections by highlighting what is at stake, particularly reproductive rights.
